description: Use a finite hand of ballistic stroke cards to intercept drifting elevated cloud greens under changing wind.

metadata.variant_count_kind: independent seeded green trajectories, wind, reflection and five difficulty profiles

name: Cloudstep Caddie V2 · Difficulty 5 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Spend every stroke card exactly once. Land on the moving greens and finish inside the cup. Sand needs LOFT. Overlapping greens at the same height support a landing when the whole ball fits one green. Card flight time and apex describe level landings; higher landings shorten flight. The wind graph and dotted green trails announce the next 2.16 seconds. The aim coordinate sets bearing and speed, not a tracked target; wind and departing-green momentum change the landing. Holding, aiming and dragging leave all greens moving. A missed landing, premature cup or incomplete certification ends this episode; no retry or world-stop control. Drag a stroke card onto the aim map coordinate and release to strike. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any other implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to pre-existing, unrelated, blank or browser-settings tabs. Tabs opened by a visible task control are allowed only when part of this task, using their visible controls.
